**8c.** Background revalidation sweep · L3867 · age triggers, premise decides; on spare capacity, never instead of the build · blocks: L3873(sql 304B)

```sql
SELECT backlog_id, queue, left(title,80) AS title
  FROM public.backlog_items
 WHERE status NOT IN ('done','removed','removal proposed')
   AND (revalidated_at IS NULL OR revalidated_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
   AND updated_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
 ORDER BY queue DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 3;
```

**9.** Write the record, then die · L4007 · write the record; ONE statement closes your row and releases the lease; THEN the gate · blocks: L4127(sql 197B) L4237(sql 384B) L4251(sql 81B) L4276(sql 69B) L4331(sql 47B) L4368(- 72B) L4383(- 98B) L4387(- 90B) L4396(- 347B) L4407(- 186B) L4443(sql 57B)

```sql
WITH released AS (
  UPDATE public.runner_lease SET holder = NULL, released_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = 1 AND holder = '<your cycle id>' RETURNING released_at)
UPDATE public.runner_cycles c SET ended_at = now(), outcome = '<outcome>'
 WHERE c.id = '<your cycle id>' AND c.ended_at IS NULL
RETURNING c.ended_at, (SELECT released_at FROM released) AS lease_released_at;
```
